calls.title: Kev Page and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book is evolving from product-led growth to a structured sales and marketing strategy, having doubled its revenue from $4 million to $8 million last year with a team of 35 employees. The company increased its sales team from 1 to 5-6 representatives to foster outbound and direct sales efforts. With a focus on product and engineering teams rather than marketers, Growth Book aims to differentiate itself in the A/B testing market, particularly with its product analytics offering. The Slack community has grown to 5,000 members, serving as a catalyst for thought leadership and customer engagement. Kevin P, a candidate with 14 years of experience in tech and developer advocacy, brings relevant insights that align with Growth Book's goals, particularly in customer-centric engagement and non-pushy advocacy strategies.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, DevRel, experimentation, product analytics, Slack community, developer advocacy
